name: Natsuki
source:
With a hot-headed temperament to compliment her small stature, Natsuki sure is feisty and in many ways, the polar opposite to Yuri. While Yuri prefers deeper darker storylines, Natsuki  favours stuff that's simple and to the point. Oh, and she's all about cuteness - although she'll never admit it.

[From the [url=https://blueskiesmod.club/characters.html]official website[/url]]
